application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
All works due to general maintenance 

Front Garden
T1	Silver birch Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by up to 2 metres. 

Front Garden
T2 (front grd)	Palm tree	Remove major deadwood throughout whole crown area (Deadwood > 25mm in diameter) including flower storks and dead fronds. 
.
H1 (rear grd, left side)	Lawson cypress	(Hedge) Retrim height of hedge by up to 1 metre/s and garden side only, creating flat top and sides as best possible. If pictures are supplied with this quote they are approximate and may change slightly on the day.

T3 (rear grd, right side)	Yew (neighbours tree)	Crown reduction (SIDE ONLY) Reduce back selected branches by approximately 1/1.5m from side of the tree only, no works to top/height. All sizes are approximate to the nearest metre.	

H2 (rear grd, right side)	Laurel (neighbours hedge)	(Hedge) No works to height of hedge, only cut back face of hedge hard to fence line. If pictures are supplied with this quote they are approximate and may change slightly on the day.
